sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games despite their most recent outing ending in defeat; they'll be looking to bounce back against a struggling Alsager side currently bottom with just 4 points. This is Sandbach's only fixture in the period.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their own recent loss and maintain pressure on the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, welcome Eccleshall (6th, 18 points) in what shapes up as a mid-table battle; both have dropped points recently with Bridgnorth losing their last two before a win. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) face Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday, then visit Brereton Social on Wednesday evening—a punishing double that could impact their title credentials. Bilston Town (5th) host Foley Meir on Saturday in another mid-table encounter. Barnton travel to Shawbury United, who are in freefall with six consecutive losses and just 10 points. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town, where both sides need wins—New Mills are on a mixed run while Drayton have lost their last two. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday; Crewe have won one recently but remain in the bottom half, while Allscott show more promising form with three recent wins. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement clash between two of the division's weakest performers. Finally, Widnes Town—pointless from their opening seven matches—host Brereton Social on Saturday, with Brereton themselves struggling after losing their last two.
